claims.claim: SemiAnalysis finds more than 300 local data-center moratoriums likely to delay only three projects, about 2.3 gigawatts of roughly 21 gigawatts in moratorium areas.
claims.episode_span: more than 300 local data-center moratoriums likely to delay only three projects
claims.source_title: 300-plus local data center bans have only delayed just three US projects
claims.supporting_quote: More than 300 local data center construction moratoriums haven’t had a massive impact on planned buildouts, with only three projects at about 2.3 out of 21 gigawatts (GW) of data centers in moratorium areas likely to be delayed

claims.claim: SemiAnalysis forecasts 38 gigawatts of U.S. data-center IT capacity in 2027, more than double 2026, of which 22 gigawatts is under vertical construction and 16 gigawatts is mostly financed.
claims.episode_span: 38 gigawatts of U.S. data-center IT capacity in 2027, more than double 2026
claims.source_title: 300-plus local data center bans have only delayed just three US projects
claims.supporting_quote: This forecast includes 38 GW of U.S. data center IT capacity in 2027, which is more than double that of 2026. Of that, 22 GW is under vertical construction, and the other 16 GW is mostly financed, with site work being done.

claims.claim: Enacted local moratoriums cover about 20 gigawatts with about 1.5 gigawatts delayed, and New York’s pause adds 0.8 gigawatts.
claims.episode_span: Enacted local moratoriums cover about 20 gigawatts, of which about 1.5 gigawatts is delayed, and New York’s pause adds 0.8 gigawatts.
claims.source_title: 300-plus local data center bans have only delayed just three US projects
claims.supporting_quote: The enacted local moratoriums cover about 20 GW with only about 1.5 GW of it delayed; New York’s pause adds 0.8 GW more.

claims.claim: Samsung will use TSMC’s three-nanometre process for NVHBM base dies, the first Samsung-TSMC collaboration at the HBM manufacturing stage.
claims.episode_span: Samsung will use TSMC’s three-nanometre process for base dies on Nvidia’s custom high-bandwidth memory, NVHBM
claims.source_title: Samsung to use TSMC technology for Nvidia's next-generation memory chips — report
claims.supporting_quote: Samsung Electronics will use TSMC's three-nanometre process to produce base dies for Nvidia's next-generation custom high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips, the Seoul Economic Daily reported on Sunday.

claims.claim: NVHBM cuts PHY area 60 percent versus standard HBM and can deliver up to 30 percent more bandwidth and 15 percent lower power than standard HBM4E.
claims.episode_span: the physical-layer area cut by 60 percent versus standard HBM, for up to 30 percent more bandwidth and 15 percent lower power than standard HBM4E
claims.source_title: Samsung Electronics Taps TSMC's 3nm Process for Nvidia Custom HBM Base Die
claims.supporting_quote: As a result, NVHBM can deliver up to 30% greater memory bandwidth and 15% lower power consumption than standard HBM4E.

claims.claim: Cho Min-sung said Razor Lake-AX will have 700 TOPS of on-die AI compute, described as 3.88 times Panther Lake’s 180 TOPS.
claims.episode_span: Razor Lake-AX will carry 700 TOPS of on-die AI compute at INT8/FP8
claims.source_title: Intel "Razor Lake-AX" to Pack 700 TOPS of AI Compute
claims.supporting_quote: Intel's senior vice president, Cho Min-sung, announced at the Semiconductors Powering Humanoids summit in South Korea that the next-generation "Razor Lake-AX" platform will be a computing powerhouse, featuring 700 TOPS of AI compute on die.

claims.claim: Governor Abbott told TCEQ to issue no data-center permits, and Bracewell says the pause applies whether or not a project is in the ERCOT queue.
claims.episode_span: Texas Governor Greg Abbott told the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality to issue no permits for data-center projects.
claims.source_title: 300-plus local data center bans have only delayed just three US projects
claims.supporting_quote: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott told the TCEQ to issue no permits for data center projects. Law firm Bracewell says this applies whether a project is in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas’s (ERCOT) queue or not

claims.claim: UBS projects HBM demand next year of about 61.5 billion gigabits, up 91 percent, against shipments of 54.6 billion gigabits, up 49 percent, an 11 percent shortfall.
claims.episode_span: next year’s HBM demand at about 61.5 billion gigabits, up 91 percent, against new shipments of 54.6 billion gigabits, up 49 percent
claims.source_title: Samsung Electronics Taps TSMC's 3nm Process for Nvidia Custom HBM Base Die
claims.supporting_quote: According to investment bank UBS, HBM demand next year is projected to reach approximately 61.5 billion Gb on a bit basis, up 91% from this year. Meanwhile, memory makers' new shipments are expected to total 54.6 billion Gb, an increase of just 49% over the same period.

claims.claim: A 1.4 nm TSMC wafer is estimated at $45,000, versus about $30,000 for a 2 nm wafer, and J.P. Morgan sees A14 mass production in the first half of 2028.
claims.episode_span: Each 1.4 nm wafer is estimated at $45,000, about half again a 2 nm wafer Digitimes put near $30,000.
claims.source_title: TSMC, Apple eye 1.4nm chips as costs surge ahead of 2028
claims.supporting_quote: Each 1.4 nm wafer from TSMC is estimated to cost $45,000. That's about half as much again as a 2 nm wafer, which Digitimes put near $30,000.

claims.claim: KeplerL2 claims PlayStation 6 RAM and NAND alone cost over $680.
claims.episode_span: hardware leaker KeplerL2 claims PlayStation 6 RAM and NAND flash alone cost over $680
claims.source_title: PS6 RAM and Storage Alone Reportedly Cost Sony Over $680, Claims Leaker
claims.supporting_quote: Hardware leaker KeplerL2 claims on NeoGAF that the RAM and NAND flash storage in Sony's next console alone cost over $680.

claims.claim: RTX Spark laptops combine a Blackwell GPU with up to 6,144 CUDA cores and a Grace CPU with up to 20 cores, up to 128 GB unified memory, and up to 1 petaflop of FP4, starting at $2,599.
claims.episode_span: a Blackwell RTX GPU with up to 6,144 CUDA cores beside a Grace CPU with up to 20 cores
claims.source_title: Nvidia RTX Spark Laptops Go On Sale With Blackwell Superchip
claims.supporting_quote: The laptops start at $2,599 and are shipping from Asus, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI.

claims.claim: Saras Micro Devices is sampling a 2 mm capacitor designed to be embedded in a PCB or package core for vertical power delivery to AI accelerators.
claims.episode_span: Saras Micro Devices is sampling a new 2 mm capacitor meant to be built into the PCB or the package core.
claims.source_title: Saras Micro Devices Embeds Capacitors to Power AI Accelerators
claims.supporting_quote: A capacitor designed to be built into the PCB or package core supports the vertical power delivery that AI chips need, and a new 2 mm part is sampling
